status.unsavedChanges: Unsaved changes — use Home Assistant's Save button to apply them.

general.homeAssistantBelowRecommended: Home Assistant {version} is below the recommended {recommended}.
general.frigateNotInstalled: Frigate integration is not installed in Home Assistant.
general.cameraTokenHelp: Use {camera} to show the active camera name. Grid mode shows {grid}.
general.prePostRollHelp: Adds {seconds} seconds before and after alert and clip playback or downloads. Requires Frigate recordings.
general.favoritesAllCamerasHelp: Shows favorites from all configured cameras. Turn off to show only the active camera.
general.fallbackUpdateCheckHelp: Fallback interval for checking new alerts and reviews. Shorter intervals use more battery and data.
general.snapshotRefreshHelp: How often snapshots refresh when Live View is off.
general.alertLiveDurationHelp: How long an alerted Preview or Wide View snapshot switches to live.

theme.applyLightMode: Apply custom theme in light mode
theme.applyDarkMode: Apply custom theme in dark mode
theme.applyBothModes: Apply custom theme in both modes
theme.draftChangesRequireSave: Draft changes require card config save.

cameraModal.frigateIntegrationRequired: Requires the Home Assistant Frigate integration.
cameraModal.secondCameraHelp: Combines two camera entities into one view, such as main and package cameras. Only the main camera provides PTZ or two-way talk.
cameraModal.mainCameraControlsHelp: Only the main camera provides PTZ and two-way talk. Put the controllable camera first.
cameraModal.lightHelp: Adds a Home Assistant light button beside the microphone. A light can be linked to multiple cameras.
cameraModal.secondLightHelp: Places the second light independently on either side of the microphone.
cameraModal.showAllReviewsHelp: Frigate groups activity into reviews that may contain alerts, detections, or both. Enable this to show every review in the Alerts tab; disable it to show alerts only.
cameraModal.ptzHelp: Adds pan and tilt controls when supported.
cameraModal.ptzRotationHelp: Rotates directional commands to match the camera image. At 90°, Up sends Left.
cameraModal.twoWayTalkHelp: Frigate requires a WebRTC backchannel. Home Assistant is experimental and requires HA WebRTC playback.
cameraModal.checkingPtzHa: Checking Frigate PTZ support. Home Assistant remains the live connection.
cameraModal.checkingPtzFrigate: Checking Frigate PTZ support for this camera.
cameraModal.ptzUnsupported: Frigate did not report PTZ pan/tilt support for this camera.
cameraModal.checkingTalkHa: Checking Home Assistant WebRTC playback support for this camera.
cameraModal.checkingTalkFrigate: Checking Frigate two-way talk support for this camera.
cameraModal.talkUnsupportedHa: Home Assistant did not report WebRTC playback for this camera, which is required for HA-direct two-way talk.
cameraModal.talkUnsupportedFrigate: Frigate did not report two-way talk support for this camera.
cameraModal.talkExperimentalHa: Experimental: Home Assistant reports WebRTC playback, but does not report talkback capability. Enable only if this camera's Home Assistant WebRTC path accepts outgoing audio.
cameraModal.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete “{camera}”? This action cannot be undone.
cameraModal.chooseLandingPageHelp: Card View will no longer be the standalone desktop and tablet view. Select the desktop and tablet landing page to use after standalone mode is disabled.
